text: It is all very well... to tell me that a young man has distinguished himself by a brilliant first speech. He may go on, or he may be satisfied with his first triumph; but show me a young man who has not succeeded at first, and nevertheless has gone on, and I will back that young man to do better than most of those who have succeeded at the first trial.
author: Samuel Smiles
speaker: Charles James Fox
locator: Chapter XI, Self-Culture, Facilities and Difficulties
